why: The court bound to the probe-only yard whose contract leaves the well-house's space without its `part`: the plan declares `part/well-house` and no space or out-of-walk region of the piece names it. The bindings check refuses the part as unbuilt, naming its use and the two repairs. It declares no unit: the part is bound on the site-plan point, and what must not bind is a declared part the piece never built.
